en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a heavily war-damaged European town by a river. In the foreground a broken iron footbridge lies collapsed into the water and a temporary timber bridge spans the river. The opposite bank is lined with ruins of houses and industrial buildings, with tall factory chimneys in the distance. Two prominent church towers dominate the skyline: one a large Gothic church with a tall pointed spire, the other a Baroque-style tower with an onion-shaped dome-like top. The image edges are worn and slightly creased. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
